dict.string: Dashros lets the agent read your calendar when you turn the Calendar capability on.
Dashros lets the agent read your calendar when you turn the Calendar capability on.
Dashros looks up contacts by name when you ask the agent about someone, and only after you switch Contacts on in Dashros ▸ Capabilities.
Dashros can read your Health data — steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts — only after you switch Apple Health on in Dashros ▸ Capabilities, and only to answer what you ask the agent.
Dashros never writes to Apple Health. It only reads, and only after you switch Apple Health on in Dashros ▸ Capabilities. This description is required because the app links HealthKit.
Dashros uses a local connection only when its optional Linux workspace is needed.

Dashros uses your location only while you are using the app, when the agent needs it for something you asked and after you switch Location on in Dashros ▸ Capabilities. Dashros does not track your location in the background.
Dashros asks for your location only when the agent needs it for something you asked, and only after you switch Location on in Dashros ▸ Capabilities. It never tracks you in the background.
Dashros lets the agent read your reminders when you turn the Reminders capability on.
Dashros lets the agent read your reminders when you turn the Reminders capability on.
